# task\-set\-status\-done\-closes — Fix setTaskStatus to close done tasks
status: todo  priority: 2  scope: scope-core
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

From the 2026\-08\-15 complete code audit: \`setTaskStatus\` \(src/core/mutate\.ts:151\) sets \`closed\_at\` only for \`wont\_do\`, so a \`review \-\> done\` transition via \`task set\-status\` leaves \`closed\_at: null\`, while the same transition via \`task finish\` \(src/core/mutate\.ts:409\) always stamps it\. Two ways of reaching \`done\` produce divergent records\. Fix: stamp \`closed\_at\` for \`done\` as well\.

## Acceptance
- \`setTaskStatus\(root, id, "done", \.\.\.\)\` on a review task sets \`closed\_at\` to the mutation timestamp\.
- \`setTaskStatus\` to \`wont\_do\` still sets \`closed\_at\`; transitions to other statuses leave it unchanged\.
- A test asserts \`task finish\` and \`set\-status done\` produce equivalent \`done\` records with respect to \`closed\_at\`\.
- All checks green: \`bun test\`, \`bun run typecheck\`, \`bun run check\`, \`waystation validate\`\.
